name: StreamSieve
description: Safely reconcile owned STRM/NFO files with stable paths, previews, and recoverable cleanup.
author: Nicholas Boulanger / shedunraid

fields.label: Root Folder for Movies
fields.help_text: Path where movie folders will be created

fields.label: Root Folder for Series
fields.help_text: Path where series folders will be created

fields.label: Dispatcharr URL (IMPORTANT!)
fields.help_text: Must be accessible from your media server; this URL is written into .strm files.

fields.label: Batch Size (Movies)
fields.help_text: Number of movies to process in this run

fields.label: Batch Size (Series)
fields.help_text: Unique whitelisted series to refresh and process in this run

fields.label: Series Whitelist (Dispatcharr IDs)
fields.help_text: Comma-separated Dispatcharr Series database IDs. Only these series are eligible; leave blank to process no series.

fields.label: Generate Series NFO Files
fields.help_text: Create .nfo metadata files for series and episodes

fields.label: Account priority (Dispatcharr IDs)
fields.help_text: Comma-separated account IDs, highest preference first. Other eligible accounts follow by relation ID.

actions.label: Initialize (series)
actions.description: Create ownership state for an existing mounted root; leaves media untouched

actions.label: Preview (series)
actions.description: Read-only preview using the current Dispatcharr catalog; no provider refresh

actions.label: Adopt matching legacy STRMs (series)
actions.description: Claim unambiguous existing Dispatcharr proxy UUIDs and preserve legacy paths; NFOs remain unmanaged

actions.label: Synchronize (series)
actions.description: Create missing files and update owned files; no automatic deletion

actions.label: Retire owned files (series)
actions.description: Copy verified owned files to sibling state/recovery storage, then remove them; series limited to current whitelist

actions.label: Initialize (movies)
actions.description: Create ownership state for an existing mounted root; leaves media untouched

actions.label: Preview (movies)
actions.description: Read-only preview using the current Dispatcharr catalog; no provider refresh

actions.label: Adopt matching legacy STRMs (movies)
actions.description: Claim unambiguous existing Dispatcharr proxy UUIDs and preserve legacy paths; NFOs remain unmanaged

actions.label: Synchronize (movies)
actions.description: Create missing files and update owned files; no automatic deletion

actions.label: Retire owned files (movies)
actions.description: Copy verified owned files to sibling state/recovery storage, then remove them; series limited to current whitelist

actions.label: Preview adoption (series)
actions.description: Read-only report of matching legacy STRMs eligible for ownership

actions.label: Preview adoption (movies)
actions.description: Read-only report of matching legacy STRMs eligible for ownership

actions.label: Preview retirement (series)
actions.description: Read-only count of owned, unmodified files eligible for recovery storage

actions.label: Restore retired files (series)
actions.description: Restore verified recovery copies without overwriting conflicting files

actions.label: Preview retirement (movies)
actions.description: Read-only count of owned, unmodified files eligible for recovery storage

actions.label: Restore retired files (movies)
actions.description: Restore verified recovery copies without overwriting conflicting files
